title: Blog post properties
description: Properties (front matter) of a note in the vault's posts/ folder. A note is published only when publish is true. tools/blogtools/schema.py validates every note against this file on each build.

title.description: Post title. Falls back to the note's file name.

id.description: Stable identity of the post across languages and renames. A Persian post and its English translation share the same id. Defaults to slug. Never change it after publishing: Telegram records are keyed by it.

slug.description: Latin, lowercase web address part: /posts/<slug>/ (Persian) or /en/posts/<slug>/ (English). Fixed after publishing.

date.description: Publish date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, Tehran time. A future date schedules the post.

updated.description: Date of the last meaningful edit. Shown on the page and used as dateModified.

publish.description: Only notes with publish: true are built. Everything else stays private.

description.description: One or two sentences for search results, link previews and Telegram. 50 to 160 characters works best.

tags.description: Topic tags. Shown on the post, listed under /tags/, and sent to Telegram as hashtags.

series.description: Name of a multi-part series this post belongs to.

cover.description: Cover image: an attachment file name (for example cover.jpg) or an https:// address.

cover_alt.description: Text description of the cover image for screen readers and search engines.

audio.description: Podcast or audio file: an attachment file name or an https:// address. Shown as a player at the top of the post.

video.description: Video address on YouTube or Aparat, or a direct .mp4 address.

toc.description: Show a table of contents when the post has at least three headings.

telegram.description: Send this post to the Telegram channel when it is first published.

aliases.description: Not allowed: in Hugo, aliases creates redirect pages, which is not what Obsidian aliases mean. Remove it from published notes.
